snippet.title: Ludus Saltuum trailer
snippet.description:
#3dplatformer #platformer #steam #steamgame #casual #minigame 
Wishlist Ludus Saltuum on steam!

store.steampowered.com/app/4832410/Ludus_Saltuum/

- Relaxing third-person gameplay!
- 30 short handcrafted levels, presented infinitely using procedural generation
- Unlock skills like multi jump, dash!
- Collect coins to buy upgrades!
- Unlock achievements as you progress!
- Gather power ups in the path to boost you!
- No text! All information is presented by numbers, symbols or images.
